method.analysis_min: .tran 2.5n 760u, saved from 600 us; 500 mA reached in 1 us at 600 us and held 160 us (~320 cycles); peak I(L) and f are read from 610 us (10 us after the step)
method.analysis_ramp: .tran 2.5n 920u, saved from 600 us; max step 2.5 ns = T/200 at 2 MHz; soft start done by 520 us (R15 max), load 0 -> 3 A linear over 300 us from 600 us (10 mA/us, ~5 mA per cycle)
method.steady_state: the ramp is quasi-static against the loop (fc 100 - 250 kHz); no steady-state claim is made on the ramp run. The min case holds 500 mA for ~320 cycles (> the 100-cycle step rule of 0.4)
method.trip: I(L) interpolated at the first rising crossing of 1.65 V (VDD33 / 2) on xtop.trip after 600 us; the digital delay between the sense crossing and TRIP is included in the value

record: simulated, not measured; pre-layout; spec R16

R16_min_bound_no_trip.note: the oscillator free-runs; a unit with f_sw above 1.7 MHz shows no trip but does not exercise the f-min condition
R16_min_bound_no_trip.what: no trip at 500 mA, L -20 %, Vin 5.5 V, all process x T, at f min (<= 1.7 MHz measured per unit); peak I(L) < 0.70 A. Judged only on units whose Vout was in regulation (>= 90 % of 1.8 V) when the 500 mA was applied

R16_trip_window.regulation_note: a unit whose Vout is below 90 % of 1.8 V when the ramp starts never finished soft start (R15 fails there); its trip value is recorded but the ramp did not start from a regulating converter
R16_trip_window.what: cycle-by-cycle limit: I(L) at first TRIP assertion while the load ramps 0 -> 3 A over 300 us, C-full; bounds 0.70 - 2.1 A (a die-protection threshold, not a precision limit)

trip.reason: TRIP never asserted in the window: no trip value
TRIP never asserted in the window: no trip value
